title: Sport Subaru South Accelerates Performance and Brand Growth With MNTN
summary: Sport Subaru South used MNTN Performance TV to gain access to an intuitive CTV platform that puts precise targeting, flexible creative testing, and transparent reporting all in one place.
body_markdown:
**Evolve from scattershot to strategic:** Launch tactical CTV campaigns that reach high-intent shoppers on premium streaming networks, ensuring they connect with the


*right* audiences at the


*right* time.


**Strengthen brand identity:** Use video storytelling to showcase their unique dealership culture and foster a sense of community among Subaru enthusiasts.


**Turn data-driven insights into impact:** Leverage transparent, actionable data to optimize budget allocation and scale CTV efforts confidently.
